recipes.name: META-TTL
setup: Prepare requirements.txt, benchmark environments and explicit OpenRouter/OpenAI environment names.
No tau2-bench profile is claimed because this pinned public tree exposes Jericho/WebArena implementations.

profiles.description: META-TTL native jericho GEPA meta-policy optimization

evaluation.description: META-TTL native jericho GEPA meta-policy optimization Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

argument_help: WebArena supports --meta_model MODEL --max_metric_calls N --max_concurrent N; Jericho settings are fixed in the native entrypoint.
limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Native train/validation split semantics and fixed model choices are retained.
Jericho ROMs or hosted WebArena sites/browser runtime must be provisioned; saved pickles are not loaded by Arena.
